description: This file is a PHP unit test class for the LeaveBalanceAPI within the OrangeHRM system. It tests various scenarios of retrieving leave balance data for employees, including single day, multi-day, partial days, holidays, and non-working days. The tests mock dependencies, set up different request parameters, and verify the API's responses and normalization outputs.

classes.description: Unit test class for testing the LeaveBalanceAPI endpoints and their expected responses under various scenarios, including different leave types, employee numbers, and date ranges.
